```yaml
name: E2E Flow Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  e2e-flows:
    if: ${{ vars.E2E_FLOWS_ENABLED == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GMAIL_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL }}
      OUTLOOK_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL }}
      NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js 20
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Install ngrok
        run: |
          curl -s https://bin.equinox.io/c/4VmDzA7iaHb/ngrok-stable-linux-amd64.zip -o ngrok.zip
          unzip ngrok.zip
          chmod +x ngrok
          sudo mv ngrok /usr/local/bin

      - name: Start application server
        run: |
          pnpm run dev &
          echo $! > server.pid
          # Give the server a moment to start
          sleep 10

      - name: Start ngrok
        run: |
          ngrok http 3000 --authtoken $NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN --log=stdout --log-format=json &
          echo $! > ngrok.pid
          # Wait for ngrok to be ready
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4040/api/tunnels | grep -q 'public_url'; then
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          NGROK_URL=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4040/api/tunnels | jq -r '.[0].public_url')
          echo "NGROK_URL=$NGROK_URL" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        env:
          NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run E2E flow tests
        run: pnpm test-e2e:flows
        env:
          NGROK_URL: ${{ env.NGROK_URL }}
          GMAIL_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL }}
          OUTLOOK_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL }}

      - name: Teardown ngrok
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f ngrok.pid ]; then
            kill $(cat ngrok.pid) || true
          fi

      - name: Teardown application server
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f server.pid ]; then
            kill $(cat server.pid) || true
          fi
```
